about_the_game:
Operation: Harsh Doorstop - Supporter Edition

Operation: Harsh Doorstop is the ultimate tactical sandbox—combining intense military combat with limitless creative potential. Inspired by classic military simulations and mod-friendly sandbox games, OHD delivers a unique experience where authentic warfare meets community-driven content. Whether you're coordinating in strategic battles or diving into player-created mods, every session offers something new.

But beyond the battlefield, some players want to take their commitment even further. That’s where the Supporter Edition comes in.

Supporter Edition Rewards

Upgrading to the Supporter Edition unlocks a range of exclusive benefits designed to bring you closer to the development process and the core community:

  • 🛠️ Development Build Access
    Get early access to experimental updates and upcoming features before they're released to the public. Be the first to test new content and provide feedback that shapes the game's future.

  • 🎉 Exclusive Servers & Special Events
    Participate in supporter-only servers and special in-game events designed for our most dedicated players. Whether it's early playtests, livestreams with developers, or capture events for trailers and cinematics, you'll always have something special to join.

  • 🏅 Supporter Tag
    Stand out on the battlefield with a unique in-game badge showing your support and dedication to the project.

Why Support?

The Supporter Edition isn't just about perks—it's about helping to push Operation: Harsh Doorstop forward. Your contribution directly supports ongoing development, helps fund new features, and strengthens the core mission of creating an open, moddable tactical shooter driven by its players.

Whether you're here for the tactical combat, the modding potential, or the community itself, the Supporter Edition is your opportunity to meaningfully contribute to Operation: Harsh Doorstop's ongoing development.

Support our project, and upgrade to the Supporter Edition today!

name: Upgrade to "Supporter Edition"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1, or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R9 270X (or equivalent with at least 2 GB of VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone for voice communications

short_description: Upgrade to the "Supporter Edition" of Operation: Harsh Doorstop and get access to the "Development Build" branch the game, among other exclusive rewards. This version of the game allows you to preview upcoming features before they are released to the public.
